title: Meta-labeling size tilt on Stop-hunt Asia resweep (L2 logistic, rank map x0.5-x1.5)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: can quant / ML meta-labeling (learn when a signal is likely to win, size it up or down) improve the strategies?
verdict: OOS AUC 0.505 (2026 H2 frozen 0.446); best model of the family gb_all AUC 0.524 permutation p 0.6139 (H2 0.9208). 2021-25 n=480 net +33,644 vs flat +33,695, 2-wk 2.9/3.8 vs 1.8/3.3, beats random sizing in 72.0%; 2026 H2 n=40 net +1,479 vs flat +2,915, 2-wk 0.0/0.0 vs 0.0/0.0, beats random sizing in 41.0%. Strict pass: False.
notes: tools/meta_label.py; research/quant/meta/sh_asia.json; sized at the strategy's own size rule x the multiplier (P&L linear in micros); trades = walk-forward OOS span trades (untested months at x1).

params.map: m = 0.5 + percentile of p among the training predictions

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
